item.title: Lake City authorities investigating deadly shooting
item.description: LAKE CITY, S.C. (WBTW) -- One person was killed Saturday in a shooting on Wallace Street in Lake City, Police Chief Patrick Miles said. Details were limited, and Miles said more information would be released as the investigation continued. Units from the Florence County Sheriff's Office also assisted. Count on News13 for updates.
